# Standard verbs

A noun that declares props and a store gets the standard verbs its store supports, with no handler of its own: a verb exists on a noun exactly when the row's kind fits the store and the store has what the row needs. A verb the noun declares by hand under a standard name replaces the generated one. A host mounting a tool's catalog gets the same verbs, forwarded.

| Verb | Kinds | Needs | Subject | Many | Repeat | History | Confirm | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get` | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Get | yes |  |  | fetch |  | Read a thing's props: every prop as an object, one prop's value (prop), or some props (props) |
| `list` | collection, instances | Store.List |  |  |  | fetch |  | List the things, each its props with id and label; where keeps the things whose props equal the values given |
| `watch` | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Watch, else Store.List (a singleton: Store.Get) | yes |  |  | fetch |  | Stream what happens to the things (one, or those where matches): a JSON line per thing added, modified or deleted, from since when given; the CLI streams until interrupted |
| `create` | collection | Store.Create and a prop create writes |  |  |  | change |  | Create a thing from the props given (each omitted one its default); answers the new thing |
| `set` (`patch`) | collection, singleton, instances | Store.Patch and a writable prop | yes | yes | yes | change |  | Write a thing's props: one prop (prop and value, or toggle on a boolean), or several (changes, or prop=value words); answers the thing after the write |
| `delete` | collection | Store.Delete | yes | yes |  | change | `Delete {{noun}} {{label}}?` | Delete a thing (asks first) |
| `rename` | collection, singleton | Store.Patch and a writable label prop (role label) | yes |  | yes | change |  | Rename a thing: write its label prop (name; to when the key prop is named name); the form opens on the old name |
| `move` | collection | Store.Patch and a writable owner reference (role owner) | yes | yes | yes | change |  | Move a thing to another owner: write its owner reference (to) |
| `duplicate` | collection | Store.Get, Store.Create and a prop create writes | yes |  |  | change |  | Create a copy of a thing: every prop create writes, from the thing, with prop=value overrides (pairs or changes); answers the new thing |
| `archive` | collection | Store.Patch and a writable archive prop (role archive) | yes | yes | yes | change |  | Archive a thing: set its archive prop |
| `restore` | collection | Store.Patch and a writable archive prop (role archive) | yes | yes | yes | change |  | Restore an archived thing: clear its archive prop |

The subject is the parameter named after the noun's key prop: given, it names the thing; left out, it is the thing the request acts for (the focus). Many runs once over a visual selection, as one undo step. Repeat: `.` repeats the write when it writes only simple values (enum, boolean, number, duration).

## Nouns with props

<a id="noun-ochazuke.page"></a>
### `ochazuke.page`

Store kind `instances`. Standard verbs: `get`, `list`, `set` (`hide`, `patch`, `show`), `watch`. Its own verbs: `next`, `open`, `pick`, `previous`.

| Prop | Type | Flags | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | key |  | The page id |
| `title` | string | read-only, role label |  | The page's title (its tab) |
| `hidden` | boolean |  |  | Out of the tabs and ctrl+j/k (the pages.hidden setting); page.open still opens it |
| `active` | boolean | read-only |  | The current page |

<a id="noun-ochazuke.setting"></a>
### `ochazuke.setting`

Store kind `collection`. Standard verbs: `get`, `list`, `watch`. Its own verbs: `add`, `append`, `cycle`, `decrease`, `edit`, `increase`, `multiply`, `prepend`, `remove`, `reset`, `revert`, `set`, `show`, `toggle`, `write` (`save`).

| Prop | Type | Flags | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | key |  | The setting's name |
| `type` | string: string, integer, number, boolean, duration, list | read-only |  | The value's type |
| `default` | string | read-only |  | The default value, in its file form (a duration as 400ms) |
| `value` | string | read-only |  | The value in effect, in its file form: the session's, else settings.json's, else the default (setting.set writes it) |
| `enum` | list | read-only |  | The values allowed, when the setting limits them |
| `description` | string | read-only |  | What the setting does |
| `section` | string | read-only |  | The Settings page section it is filed under ("" is General) |
| `owner` | string: ochazuke, app | read-only |  | Who declared it: ochazuke or the application |
| `origin` | string: default, file, session | read-only |  | Where the value in effect comes from: the default, settings.json or this session (setting.show --verbose says more) |
